assets.statement: Zero-step degenerate walk (S∋0, constant walk, singleton A) satisfies all stated premises and violates the conclusion; statement needs 0∉S and infinitely many distinct points before the real conjecture is engaged.

All-primes choice makes the a_k sequence finite, violating the canonical premise; vacuous-goodness argument is domain drift, needs an infinite survivor construction plus literal quantifier-order verification.

A=ℝ satisfies the frozen premise (infinite subset of ℝ) but defeats the conclusion, since every affine image aA+b is all of ℝ and no proper E contains it; the canonical universal statement is false as written and requires an added smallness hypothesis on A.

L1-as-branch-B-evidence fails: Maynard bound is subsequence-only (hidden-subsequence attack) and does not match the quantifier reversal of o(log N) (needs all-N failure at positive density, not infinitely many N); repair = uniform c·log N lower bound on the full primes, an equivalent-strength open p

refuted by explicit divergence: min-colouring is an infinite affirmative witness for m≤κ but a finite counterexample in every tested finite instance, so finite-to-infinite transfer fails and no close is computable.

Exact witness Grötzsch graph (11v, 20e, triangle-free, chi=4): every triangle-free 4-subset has no odd cycle so D_G(4)=0, hence the small-n defect constraint cannot bound chi; imported structural lesson erdos740 R009/L1 adapted (K4 obstructions priced exactly by L2), binding difficulty is asymptotic
